name: whatsapp-bridge-mcp
description: Read, search and safely send WhatsApp messages. Self-healing connection; read-only by default.
long_description: Links to your WhatsApp account as a linked device (like WhatsApp Web) and exposes tools to list chats, read and search messages, find contacts and send messages. Sending is off by default; when enabled every message needs your explicit confirmation, unknown numbers are blocked and rate limits apply to protect your account. Uses an installed Chrome or Edge browser.

tools.name: whatsapp_login
tools.description: Link this device with a QR code

tools.name: whatsapp_confirm_send
tools.description: Send a prepared message after approval

send_enabled.title: Allow sending messages
send_enabled.description: Off = read-only. When on, every message still needs your confirmation.

allow_unknown_recipients.title: Allow messaging numbers you never chatted with
allow_unknown_recipients.description: Not recommended: messaging strangers is the most common cause of WhatsApp bans.
